en.headline: 7 own commits plus 3 automated; 2 issues opened on anomalyco/opencode
en.summary: On 2026-10-16, `sogeisetsu` recorded **7 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, plus 3 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. The own commits were all documentation work: adding `AGENTS.md` and noting the origin remote, creating a `knowledge/` base for Git & GitHub findings with Excalidraw sketches, generalizing the knowledge scope from Git/GitHub to broader topics, making knowledge supplementation a default action in the agents doc, and archiving OpenCode V2 distribution/architecture/auth notes along with Windows path pitfalls and oh-my-opencode-slim / hosted OpenCode findings. No pull requests, reviews, releases, stars, or discussions were recorded. Two issues were opened on `anomalyco/opencode`: `#55785` reporting that `mimo-v2.6-flash` and `mimo-v2.5` advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects every image with 400, and `#55772` requesting a way to run the CLI shipped with the Windows desktop build. No replies, state changes, or truncation were reported.

zh.headline: 7 次本人提交加 3 次自动提交；在 anomalyco/opencode 新开 2 个 issue
zh.summary: 2026-10-16，`sogeisetsu` 在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 完成 **7 次本人提交**，另有 3 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。本人提交均为文档工作：新增 `AGENTS.md` 并记录 origin 远程，创建 `knowledge/` 目录归档 Git & GitHub 相关发现并附 Excalidraw 草图，将 knowledge 范围从 Git/GitHub 泛化为更广泛的主题，把 knowledge 补充改为 agents 文档中的默认动作，并归档 OpenCode V2 分发/架构/认证笔记、Windows 路径坑以及 oh-my-opencode-slim 与托管 OpenCode 的实测知识。当日无 PR、review、release、star 或 discussion 记录。在 `anomalyco/opencode` 新开了 2 个 issue：`#55785` 反映 `mimo-v2.6-flash` 与 `mimo-v2.5` 声称支持图像输入但 Go 端点会以 400 拒绝所有图像，`#55772` 请求为 Windows 桌面版随附的 CLI 提供运行方式。无回复、无状态变更，也未触发任何截断。
